page.overview:
What is Uvhash?

Uvhash, also known as The Blood-Mad God of the Void, is a fictional deity created by American author James Ambuehl for his short Cthulhu Mythos story " The Advent of Uvhash".

A gigantic, vampiric red mass of eyes and tentacles, Uvhash is the archenemy of the being known as Gi-Hoveg. It dwells in the realm of Rhylkos, which is linked to the planet Mars, and it is said that whoever summons Uvhash will meet with a terrible fate.

Uvhash seems to have affinities with the Star Vampires and the Hounds of Tindalos, and is rumoured to have been one of the mad Roman Emperor Caligula's eldritch sponsors in the Cthulhu Mythos. (: "The Advent of Uvhash")

In the short story "The Advent of Uvhash", Uvhash consumed the soul of a man who was attempting astral projection under the patronage of its arch-enemy Gi-Hoveg.
